Be a Storyteller: Ask your child to retell the story of the 'Four Friends' (Deer, Crow, Rat, Turtle) using their toys as actors! 🦌🐦🐁🐢
Number Names Challenge: See how fast your child can write the number names for 51 to 60 from their math book. ✍️
Phonics Hunt: Challenge your child to look around the room and find 3 things that start with 'cl', 'fl', or 'pl' blends. 🔍
Let's play 'Teacher'! Have your child teach you the 'Lion and the Mouse' story they learned in Kannada class. 🦁🐭
Shape Detectives: Ask your child to find 3 things in the house that are spheres (like a ball) and 3 things that are cubes (like a box)! 🧊⚽
Hindi Handwriting Hero: Have your child practice writing their five favorite letters from the Nirjhar Moti book. 📝
Values Time: They recently learned about 'God is one'. Ask them to draw a beautiful picture showing everyone living together happily! 🌍🖍️
Time Keepers: Point to the wall clock and ask your child to tell you what time it is, just like they learned in Numeracy! ⏰
Vowel Catchers: Ask your child to make a list of 5 words they know that have the long 'a' or 'i' sound (like cake or bike). 🅰️
Little Shopper: Give them some pretend coins (or real ones!) and play 'Shop' together like they learned in their Money chapter. 🪙🛍️
Living or Non-Living?: Have your child touch 5 things in their room and declare out loud if they are 'Living' or 'Non-Living'. 🌿🪨
Dictation Sprint: Give your child a quick 5-word dictation test on 'r' blends (like crab, frog, green). 🐸
Ascending Stairs: Challenge them to arrange their toys or books from smallest to largest! 📚
Action Hero: Call out action words (jump, clap, smile, sleep) and have your child perform the action as fast as possible! 🏃‍♂️
Kannada Numbers: Challenge your child to say the numbers 1 to 20 in Kannada as fast as they can! 🔢
Nature Saver: They learned 'Save our nature'. Ask them to find one way to save water or paper in the house today! 💧🌳
Data Detective: Tell them to group their toys by color and count which color has the most items, like a Pictograph! 📊
Opposites Game: Take turns with your child saying opposites (Hot/Cold, Big/Small). See who runs out of words first! ⬆️⬇️
Rhyme Time: Ask them to sing their favorite school rhyme with all the actions! 🎶🙌
Sentence Builder: Have your child write 2 simple sentences in their 4-line notebook using the naming words 'cat' and 'ball'. 📓
